title: Link plots, controls, and a table
description: Five Palmer penguins per species, so every row a selection touches is visible in the table beside the chart.

journey.pointer: Select points in either plot, hover or focus table controls to emphasize rows, and use the external controls to update every linked view.
journey.keyboard: Tab to a plot and press Enter or Space to select its focused point. Continue into the table to toggle or emphasize rows with ordinary buttons.
journey.touch: Tap points in either plot or use the large external controls; linked selection updates both plots and the table.
